commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' One of the players from Ath Bilbao times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao), but it's just wide of the right post.
90+2' Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' What was Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
82' That's unlucky! Joao Felix (Barcelona) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
80' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) replacing Benat Prados Diaz.
78' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
78' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
76' Xavi decides to make a substitution. Andreas Christensen will be replaced by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona).
76' Today's match ends for Raphinha who will be replaced by Joao Felix (Barcelona).
76' Substitution. Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) has come on for Pau Cubarsi.
76' Here is a change. Gorka Guruzeta is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
76' It is time for a substitution. Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) is on for Inaki Williams.
72' The corner kick from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
71' A cross from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Barcelona for a penalty. Play continues.
67' The attendance is 50295.
65' Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
64' Here comes a substitution. Unai Gomez is given a rest as he is replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
63' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Mikel Vesga is replaced by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).
63' The cross into the penalty area from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
62' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
61' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
60' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
58' A pass from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Marc-Andre ter Stegen and the move breaks down.
57' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
55' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross from the corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen reads it well and gathers the ball.
55' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' The game is interrupted. Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
51' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!
50' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
50' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
48' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
47' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A dangerous looking corner kick from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Barcelona get a corner.
45+3' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Pedri is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
44' Pedri (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
41' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
37' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a smart save to deny him.
37' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
33' Xavi (Barcelona) gets a yellow card, off the field.
32' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Alejandro Hernandez ignores the protests.
31' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
28' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
26' Problems for Xavi as Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Fermin Lopez replaces him.
23' The game is interrupted now, Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
21' A player from Ath Bilbao commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
21' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Ath Bilbao.
18' Ath Bilbao hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
16' PENALTY APPEAL by Ath Bilbao, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
14' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the left post.
14' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
14' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
10' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header high over the bar from close in.
10' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao). Barcelona have been awarded a free kick.
9' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
7' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
4' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Hernandez saw the whole situation.
3' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has just begun.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will supervise the game today.
